svg.title: Lord of Abandoned Success: Eight of Cups · Saturn in Pisces · Hod (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Saturn above the painting and Pisces below, as Book T places them: "At the top and bottom of the card are symbols Saturn and Pisces."
